data.one_liner: A BoxBorder that draws part of a border based on progress.
data.what_it_does: Draws a partial border around circles, rectangles, and rounded rectangles according to a progress value. It supports background borders, background colors, and gradients.
use_when: You need to animate a border drawing around a container based on progress
You want to create circular or rectangular progress indicators using borders
avoid_when: You need complex custom path metric caching features that are not yet implemented
You are using a Flutter version lower than 3.7 (unless using version 0.0.x)
strengths: Supports circle, rect, and rectangle shapes
Allows background border and gradient painters
weaknesses: PathMetric cache and Custom Paint features are still under construction
Limited documentation beyond the basic README example
